reference: I.Y. Ignateva, O.M. Barabash, and T.N. Legkaya, Superhard Mater., 12, 1-5 (1990); compiled in H. Okamoto, Desk Handbook: Phase Diagrams for Binary Alloys, 2nd ed., ASM International, Materials Park, OH (2010), p. 224
comment: evidence_class=assessed_phase_diagram (expert-drawn diagram, not experimental, not CALPHAD); ORCHID assessed-phase-assemblages v1.0.0, diagram C-MG-p224; one point per phase field (centroid or pole of inaccessibility); single-phase: the phase at the point composition; two-phase: phases present, compositions unknown (null) with __HYPERPLANE__ at the point's overall composition.
